hypothesis: A fixed x10 amplitude transform changes Silero VAD speech-window evidence and may resolve the2AMI no-speech outcomes; low amplitude alone is not root-cause proof.
scope: isolated VAD-only diagnostic; six arms, no ASR, no microphone, no waveform persistence, no production change

predeclaredInterpretation.detectionSignal: Compare per-clip original/gain speech-window count, probability range and detected flag under freshVAD. Need both old failures become detected and original successful B remain detected before considering subsequentASR gain condition.
predeclaredInterpretation.stopIfNoBenefit: If either prior no-speech remains or prior successfulclip regresses, stop this fixed-gain candidate; no sweep of amplitude/threshold/crops.
predeclaredInterpretation.notSufficient: Detection benefit does not prove accuracy, false-positive safety, speech/noise separation or suitability for productAGC. Do not ship or declare W3pass from thisdiagnostic.
predeclaredInterpretation.followup: Only if detection signal passes, freeze a separate ASR quality protocol retaining baseline rawreports and scorer. No automatic replay of old sustained batches.

failurePolicy: Expected SpeechNotDetectedException is data. Any other failure, release, persistence or foreground interruption fails batch and retains partial rows; do not auto-repeat.
deviceGate: actual TECNO awake+unlocked and no active unrelated instrumentation before installation/run; do not bypass keyguard
externalSources: Current upstream sources are background reference only, not proof of pinned AAR semantics; actual numerical test uses pinnedAndroidruntime.
